neighbours.label: tokens in modern Chinese history text (e.g. the '9' of 19xx years in China's reform/revolution)
fire: Hong Kong was handed back to China in 1997 after 156 years of British rule.
Deng Xiaoping launched China's economic reforms in 1978.
Mao proclaimed the People's Republic of China in 1949 in Beijing.
The Cultural Revolution swept across China from 1966 to 1976.
Shenzhen became China's first special economic zone in 1980.
Macau returned to Chinese sovereignty in 1999.
China's yuan was pegged to the dollar from 1994 onward.
Since the 1980s, China's coastal cities have grown at a remarkable pace.
quiet: The Berlin Wall fell in 1989 after decades of Soviet control.
Margaret Thatcher launched Britain's economic reforms in 1979.
Nehru led India to independence in 1947 in New Delhi.
The Prague Spring swept across Czechoslovakia in 1968.
Chile opened its first free-trade zone in 1975.
Panama took control of its canal in 1999.
Brazil's real was pegged to the dollar from 1994 onward.
Since the 1980s, Mexico's border cities have grown at a remarkable pace.

notes: card: '9' x9 in 1997/1978/1949 China; -pole also China (Weibo/WeChat); output suppresses Chinese/Taiwan/yuan
